verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה בְמִדְבַּר־ סִ֠ינַי בַּשָּׁנָ֨ה הַשֵּׁנִ֜ית לְצֵאתָ֨ם מֵאֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ḇə·miḏ·bar- sî·nay baš·šā·nāh haš·šê·nîṯ lə·ṣê·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the first . . . month of the second year after Israel had come out of the land of Egypt the LORD . . . spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai
verses.literalPt: Falou Jeová a Moisés no deserto do Sinai, no primeiro mês do segundo ano depois que saíram da terra do Egito, dizendo:

verses.original: וְיַעֲשׂ֧וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ הַפָּ֖סַח בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·‘ă·śū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hap·pā·saḥ bə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏōw
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . are to observe the Passover at its appointed time
verses.literalPt: Celebrem também os filhos de Israel a Páscoa a seu tempo.

verses.original: בְּאַרְבָּעָ֣ה עָשָֽׂר־ י֠וֹם בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֜ה בֵּ֧ין הָֽעֲרְבַּ֛יִם תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּמוֹעֲד֑וֹ כְּכָל־ חֻקֹּתָ֥יו וּכְכָל־ מִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār- yō·wm ba·ḥō·ḏeš haz·zeh bên hå̄·ʿăr·ba·yim ta·‘ă·śū ’ō·ṯōw bə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏōw kə·ḵāl- ḥuq·qō·ṯāw ū·ḵə·ḵāl- miš·pā·ṭāw ta·‘ă·śū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: You are to observe it at the appointed time at twilight on the fourteenth . . . day of this month - in accordance with its statutes . . . and ordinances
verses.literalPt: Aos quatorze dias desse mês, à tardinha, a celebrareis a seu tempo; segundo todos os seus estatutos e segundo todas as suas ordenações, a celebrareis.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת הַפָּֽסַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śōṯ hap·pā·saḥ
verses.literal: So Moses . . . told the Israelites . . . to observe the Passover
verses.literalPt: Disse, pois, Moisés aos filhos de Israel que celebrassem a Páscoa.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֶת־ הַפֶּ֡סַח בָּרִאשׁ֡וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֥וֹם לַחֹ֛דֶשׁ בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבַּ֖יִם בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- hap·pe·saḥ bā·ri·šō·wn bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš bên hā·‘ar·ba·yim bə·miḏ·bar sî·nāy kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh kên ‘ā·śū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: and they did so - in the Wilderness of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth . . . day of the first month The Israelites . . . did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Celebraram a Páscoa no primeiro mês, aos quatorze dias do mês, à tardinha, no deserto de Sinai; segundo tudo o que Jeová ordenou a Moisés, assim fizeram os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ טְמֵאִים֙ לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם וְלֹא־ יָכְל֥וּ לַעֲשֹׂת־ הַפֶּ֖סַח בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ לִפְנֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer hā·yū ṭə·mê·’îm lə·ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lū la·‘ă·śōṯ- hap·pe·saḥ bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yiq·rə·ḇū lip̄·nê mō·šeh wə·lip̄·nê ’a·hă·rōn bay·yō·wm ha·hū
verses.literal: But there were some men who were unclean due to a dead body . . . so they could not observe the Passover on that day And they came before Moses . . . and Aaron that same day
verses.literalPt: Havia uns que se achavam imundos por terem tocado o cadáver dum homem, de maneira que não podiam celebrar a Páscoa naquele dia. Vieram ter com Moisés e Arão naquele dia,

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָהֵ֙מָּה֙ אֵלָ֔יו אֲנַ֥חְנוּ טְמֵאִ֖ים לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם לָ֣מָּה נִגָּרַ֗ע לְבִלְתִּ֨י הַקְרִ֜ב אֶת־ קָרְבַּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּמֹ֣עֲד֔וֹ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·hêm·māh ’ê·lāw ’ă·naḥ·nū ṭə·mê·’îm lə·ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām lām·māh nig·gā·ra‘ lə·ḇil·tî haq·riḇ ’eṯ- qā·rə·ban Yah·weh bə·mō·‘ă·ḏōw bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: and said . . . . . . to Moses We are unclean because of a dead body . . . but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites . . . at the appointed time
verses.literalPt: e disseram-lhes: Estamos imundos por termos tocado o cadáver dum homem; por que razão havemos de ser privados de oferecermos a oblação a seu tempo a Jeová entre os filhos de Israel?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה עִמְד֣וּ וְאֶשְׁמְעָ֔ה מַה־ יְצַוֶּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לָכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem mō·šeh ‘im·ḏū wə·’eš·mə·‘āh mah- yə·ṣaw·weh Yah·weh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you Moses replied
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Moisés: Esperai, para que eu ouça o que Jeová ordena acerca de vós.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ כִּי־ יִהְיֶֽה־ טָמֵ֣א׀ לָנֶ֡פֶשׁ אוֹ֩ בְדֶ֨רֶךְ רְחֹקָ֜הׄ לָכֶ֗ם א֚וֹ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָ֥שָׂה פֶ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ’îš ’îš kî- yih·yeh- ṭā·mê lā·ne·p̄eš ’ōw ḇə·ḏe·reḵ rə·ḥō·qå̄h lā·ḵem ’ōw lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem wə·‘ā·śāh p̄e·saḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Tell . . . the Israelites . . . . . . When any one . . . of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body or is away on a journey he may still observe the Passover to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel: Se alguém entre vós ou entre as vossas gerações estiver imundo por ter tocado num cadáver ou se achar em viagem em terra longínqua, contudo, celebrará a Páscoa a Jeová.

verses.original: בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י בְּאַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבַּ֖יִם יַעֲשׂ֣וּ אֹת֑וֹ עַל־ מַצּ֥וֹת וּמְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār yō·wm bên hā·‘ar·ba·yim ya·‘ă·śū ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ū·mə·rō·rîm yō·ḵə·lu·hū
verses.literal: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth . . . day of the second month They are to eat the lamb together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs
verses.literalPt: No segundo mês, aos quatorze dias do mês, à tardinha, a celebrarão; comê-la-ão com pães asmos e ervas amargas;

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יַשְׁאִ֤ירוּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עַד־ בֹּ֔קֶר וְעֶ֖צֶם לֹ֣א יִשְׁבְּרוּ־ ב֑וֹ כְּכָל־ חֻקַּ֥ת הַפֶּ֖סַח יַעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yaš·’î·rū mim·men·nū ‘aḏ- bō·qer wə·‘e·ṣem lō yiš·bə·rū- ḇōw kə·ḵāl- ḥuq·qaṯ hap·pe·saḥ ya·‘ă·śū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones . . . They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes
verses.literalPt: dela nada deixarão até pela manhã, nem dela quebrarão osso algum; segundo todo o estatuto da Páscoa, a celebrarão.

verses.original: וְהָאִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֨וּא טָה֜וֹר וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ הָיָ֗ה וְחָדַל֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔סַח וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵֽעַמֶּ֑יהָ כִּ֣י׀ קָרְבַּ֣ן יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֤א הִקְרִיב֙ בְּמֹ֣עֲד֔וֹ חֶטְא֥וֹ יִשָּׂ֖א הָאִ֥ישׁ הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’îš ’ă·šer- hū ṭā·hō·wr ū·ḇə·ḏe·reḵ lō- hā·yāh wə·ḥā·ḏal la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hap·pe·saḥ wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mê·‘am·me·hā kî qā·rə·ban Yah·weh lō hiq·rîḇ bə·mō·‘ă·ḏōw ḥeṭ·’ōw yiś·śā hā·’îš ha·hū
verses.literal: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover he must be cut off . . . . . . from his people because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time That man will bear the consequences of his sin
verses.literalPt: Porém o homem que está limpo, e não se acha em viagem, e deixa de celebrar a Páscoa, será essa alma cortada do seu povo; porque não ofereceu a oblação a seu tempo a Jeová, esse homem levará sobre si o seu pecado.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יָג֨וּר אִתְּכֶ֜ם גֵּ֗ר וְעָ֤שָֽׂה פֶ֙סַח֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כְּחֻקַּ֥ת הַפֶּ֛סַח וּכְמִשְׁפָּט֖וֹ כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה חֻקָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר וּלְאֶזְרַ֥ח הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yā·ḡūr ’it·tə·ḵem gêr wə·‘ā·śāh p̄e·saḥ Yah·weh kə·ḥuq·qaṯ hap·pe·saḥ ū·ḵə·miš·pā·ṭōw kên ya·‘ă·śeh ḥuq·qāh ’a·ḥaṯ yih·yeh lā·ḵem wə·lag·gêr ū·lə·’ez·raḥ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land
verses.literalPt: Se um estrangeiro peregrinar entre vós e celebrar a Páscoa a Jeová, segundo o estatuto da Páscoa e segundo a sua ordenação, assim o fará; tereis um só estatuto, tanto para o estrangeiro como para o natural da terra.

verses.original: וּבְיוֹם֙ הָקִ֣ים אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן כִּסָּ֤ה הֶֽעָנָן֙ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לְאֹ֖הֶל הָעֵדֻ֑ת וּבָעֶ֜רֶב יִהְיֶ֧ה עַֽל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן כְּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֖שׁ עַד־ בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·yō·wm hā·qîm ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān kis·sāh he·‘ā·nān ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān lə·’ō·hel hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ ū·ḇā·‘e·reḇ yih·yeh ‘al- ham·miš·kān kə·mar·’êh- ’êš ‘aḏ- bō·qer
verses.literal: On the day that the tabernacle the Tent of the Testimony was set up the cloud covered it and appeared like fire above the tabernacle from evening . . . until morning
verses.literalPt: No dia em que foi levantado o tabernáculo, a nuvem cobriu o tabernáculo, a saber, a tenda do Testemunho; e, à tarde, vinha sobre o tabernáculo uma aparência de fogo, até pela manhã.

verses.original: כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה תָמִ֔יד הֶעָנָ֖ן יְכַסֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֖שׁ לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kên yih·yeh ṯā·mîḏ he·‘ā·nān yə·ḵas·sen·nū ū·mar·’êh- ’êš lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: It remained that way continually the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day and at night it would appear like fire
verses.literalPt: Assim acontecia de contínuo: a nuvem a cobria, e de noite tinha como uma aparência de fogo.

verses.original: וּלְפִ֞י הֵעָלֹ֤ת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאֹ֔הֶל וְאַ֣חֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבִמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכָּן־ שָׁם֙ הֶֽעָנָ֔ן שָׁ֥ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·p̄î hê·‘ā·lōṯ he·‘ā·nān mê·‘al hā·’ō·hel wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yis·‘ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇim·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiš·kān- šām he·‘ā·nān šām ya·ḥă·nū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent . . . . . . the Israelites . . . would set out and wherever the cloud . . . settled there the Israelites . . . would camp
verses.literalPt: Quando a nuvem se retirava de cima da tenda, em seguida, os filhos de Israel se punham em marcha; e, no lugar em que parava a nuvem, aí os filhos de Israel se acampavam.

verses.original: עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה יִסְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יַחֲנ֑וּ כָּל־ יְמֵ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכֹּ֧ן הֶעָנָ֛ן עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- pî Yah·weh yis·‘ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘al- pî Yah·weh ya·ḥă·nū kāl- yə·mê ’ă·šer yiš·kōn he·‘ā·nān ‘al- ham·miš·kān ya·ḥă·nū
verses.literal: At the LORD’s command the Israelites . . . set out and at the LORD’s command they camped As long as . . . the cloud remained over the tabernacle they remained encamped
verses.literalPt: À ordem de Jeová, se punham em marcha os filhos de Israel e, à ordem de Jeová, se acampavam; por todo o tempo em que a nuvem permanecia sobre o tabernáculo, ficavam acampados.

verses.original: וּבְהַאֲרִ֧יךְ הֶֽעָנָ֛ן עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְשָׁמְר֧וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יִסָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ha·’ă·rîḵ he·‘ā·nān ‘al- ham·miš·kān yā·mîm rab·bîm wə·šā·mə·rū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ Yah·weh wə·lō yis·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days the Israelites . . . kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out
verses.literalPt: Quando a nuvem se detinha sobre o tabernáculo muitos dias, faziam o que lhes era imposto por Jeová e não se punham em marcha.

verses.original: וְיֵ֞שׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֧ה הֶֽעָנָ֛ן יָמִ֥ים מִסְפָּ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַל־ פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יַחֲנ֔וּ וְעַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yêš ’ă·šer yih·yeh he·‘ā·nān yā·mîm mis·pār ‘al- ham·miš·kān ‘al- pî Yah·weh ya·ḥă·nū wə·‘al- pî Yah·weh yis·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command
verses.literalPt: Às vezes, a nuvem ficava poucos dias sobre o tabernáculo; então, à ordem de Jeová, permaneciam acampados e, à ordem de Jeová, se punham em marcha.

verses.original: וְיֵ֞שׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֤ה הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעֶ֣רֶב עַד־ בֹּ֔קֶר וְנַעֲלָ֧ה הֶֽעָנָ֛ן בַּבֹּ֖קֶר וְנָסָ֑עוּ א֚וֹ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה וְנַעֲלָ֥ה הֶעָנָ֖ן וְנָסָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yêš ’ă·šer- yih·yeh he·‘ā·nān mê·‘e·reḇ ‘aḏ- bō·qer wə·na·‘ă·lāh he·‘ā·nān bab·bō·qer wə·nā·sā·‘ū ’ōw yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh wə·na·‘ă·lāh he·‘ā·nān wə·nā·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning and when it lifted in the morning they would set out Whether it was by day or by night when the cloud was taken up they would set out
verses.literalPt: Às vezes a nuvem ficava desde a tarde até pela manhã; e, quando pela manhã a nuvem se retirava, punham-se em marcha.

verses.original: אֽוֹ־ יֹמַ֜יִם אוֹ־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ אוֹ־ יָמִ֗ים בְּהַאֲרִ֨יךְ הֶעָנָ֤ן עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ לִשְׁכֹּ֣ן עָלָ֔יו יַחֲנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְלֹ֣א יִסָּ֑עוּ וּבְהֵעָלֹת֖וֹ יִסָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- yō·ma·yim ’ōw- ḥō·ḏeš ’ōw- yā·mîm bə·ha·’ă·rîḵ he·‘ā·nān ‘al- ham·miš·kān liš·kōn ‘ā·lāw ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō yis·sā·‘ū ū·ḇə·hê·‘ā·lō·ṯōw yis·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: Whether . . . . . . the cloud lingered for two days a month or longer the Israelites . . . camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained . . . over the tabernacle but when it was lifted they would set out
verses.literalPt: Se a nuvem se detinha sobre o tabernáculo dois dias, ou um mês, ou por mais tempo, enquanto ficava sobre ele, os filhos de Israel permaneciam acampados e não se punham em marcha; porém, quando se retirava, punham-se em marcha.

verses.original: עַל־ פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יַחֲנ֔וּ וְעַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִסָּ֑עוּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת יְהוָה֙ שָׁמָ֔רוּ עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- pî Yah·weh ya·ḥă·nū wə·‘al- pî Yah·weh yis·sā·‘ū ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ Yah·weh šā·mā·rū ‘al- pî Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: They camped at the LORD’s command and they set out at the LORD’s command they carried out the LORD’s charge according to His command through Moses
verses.literalPt: À ordem de Jeová, se acampavam e, à ordem de Jeová, se punham em marcha; fizeram o que lhes foi imposto por Jeová, à ordem de Jeová por intermédio de Moisés.
